title: Unsafe concurrent &mut access to native Identity/Session handles

title: E2EE identity persisted before one-time keys generated; OTK private state never re-serialized
notes:
class=DATA_INCONSISTENCY; explanation=createAndPersistFirstIdentity() serializes and writes anox_identity.enc with zero one-time keys. CryptoBridgeLocalE2eeIdentityStep.ensurePublicIdentityMaterial() then calls generateOneTimeKeys() and getOneTimeKey() on the in-memory identity and uploads the public OTKs, but never calls saveIdentity() to persist the updated identity. A crash or process restart after upload leaves the server with a set of public OTKs whose private counterparts were never durably serialized; on retry the identity is loaded from the old file, a new random set of OTKs is generated and uploaded, and the client can no longer decrypt messages targeting the first set.; fix=Generate OTKs before the first serialization and persist the identity with the OTKs, or call saveIdentity() after OTK generation and before/after upload.
